label: Early original-phase steps shortly after a q (also after a / p)
explanation: Fires almost only in the original (input) phase at positions 1-5, 96% of mass, peaking at t=2-3; never at t=0 and essentially never in the copy phase. The strongest driver is the previous input being q (rate 41%, 55% of mass): every top activation is the step right after a q, and q q <x> gives the maximum on the token after the second q. The activation decays over the next 1-2 steps after a q (prev2_tok q also has high lift). Weaker triggers are a previous a or p. Lower-quartile activations are scattered weak firings at early positions with no clear token trigger. It does not fire after q late in long sequences (t>=6). Some firing on the delimiter step (3% of mass) shows up when a q came just before <DEL>.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the previous input (most: q, a, p, g, <DEL>, b; least: i, j, h, r) and the input two steps back (most: q, p, a, g, u, 3; least: i, j, h, r); timing cues that raise it most: t=3, t=2, t=4.
